title: 第25章 别墅伤的重不重？
novel_title: 财神爷加好友！我被神仙团宠暴富(舒起起)
content_zh: 温栩栩把那个价值一百二十万的“咸菜罐”小心翼翼地塞进行李袋最深处，这才直起腰，回头看了一眼自已的床铺。被子枕头已经被那些破烂压得看不出原样，床单上沾着不明污渍，空气里那股烟味混着霉味，闻得她想yue。她默默下了判断：这宿舍，住不了一点。还好她的重要物品都锁在柜子里。温栩栩手上戴着打扫宿舍卫生时用的手套，小心翼翼的把堆在柜子前的废品扒拉开。越乱的地方越容易开出“小可爱”，蟑螂、蜈蚣、不知名的虫子，谁知道这些破烂里藏着什么。温栩栩继续翻着挡在柜子前的杂物，刚拨开一个塑料袋，动作忽然顿住。一个喝了一半的珍珠奶茶杯，杯口大敞着，杯壁上趴着两只棕红色的东西，细细的触须还在动。雾草！蟑螂！！！她的手指悬在半空，全身血液瞬间涌上头顶。第一反应是尖叫。第二反应是甩手。第三反应——她死死咬住下唇，把那声冲到嗓子眼的尖叫硬生生吞了回去。不能叫。叫了那俩人就会看过来。看过来就会注意到她在收拾什么。以防万一，小心为上，稳妥把这茶罐带走再说。温栩栩深吸一口气，用两根手指捏起那个奶茶杯的盖子，轻轻盖了回去。动作很轻，很稳，像在处理什么易碎品。她把那个封好的杯子放到一边，继续收拾别的。全程没有发出一点声音。那两个室友一个翘着腿刷手机，一个已经躺平睡觉，完全没注意到她刚才经历了什么。温栩栩低着头，她继续挑挑拣拣地收拾重要的东西，课本、画具。至于那些被弄脏的床单被子，她连碰都不想碰。反正也不住了。等把这个罐子转手，自已全身上下加起来就有两百多万。两百多万，谁还住宿舍吸二手烟、跟蟑螂做室友啊？温栩栩拎起收拾好的行李袋，走到门口，脚步顿了顿。她回头看了一眼。陈静已经睡得死沉死沉的，追剧女生已经戴着耳机躺下了。没人注意自已。温栩栩轻手轻脚地退回去，从地上拎起那个封好的奶茶杯，往陈静床头一放。杯子稳稳当当立在那儿，杯壁上那两只棕红色的小东西还在悠闲地爬来爬去。温栩栩满意地看了一眼。陈静不是喜欢欺负弱小吗？不是喜欢找乐子吗？给她送两只小宠物，慢慢玩。温栩栩转身火速溜出门。——宿舍走廊里，温栩栩刚松口气，正想着晚上去哪儿落脚，手机突然响了。是个陌生号码，但显示是京海市本地。她迟疑了一秒，滑动接听。对面传来一个有点耳熟又好听的男声：“温栩栩？青林湾188号，独栋，带院子，你看什么时候方便过来——”温栩栩脑子还在想今晚住哪儿，一听这话，以为对面是要给她推销房产看房了，条件反射般地打断：“不买不买！别墅买不起！我就一穷学生，你别找我推销了！”电话那头安静了两秒。温栩栩越说越来劲，压低声音嘀咕：“怎么回事啊，刚有点钱，房产中介就闻着味儿找上门了？这也太快了吧……”对面的声音再次响起，带着一丝难以言喻的复杂情绪：“……温栩栩，我是司凛。”温栩栩一愣：“司凛……？”他们学校校草？对面司凛见温栩栩慢半拍的反应，又沉默了一秒，声音里带上了一点无奈：“就是你抱着我让我赔别墅的那个。”“兰博基尼，牛棚，想起来了吗？”温栩栩脑子里“轰”地一下，终于把这段记忆从某个犄角旮旯里刨了出来——司凛！那个开兰博基尼把她家牛棚撞穿的校草司凛！他醒了！温栩栩脑子里瞬间闪过两个念头：第一，月老那个“极品桃花运”红包，还真不是闹着玩的？！第二，也是最重要的，司凛真的要给她赔别墅？！温栩栩握着手机的手一紧，第一反应是问别墅，但又觉得这样太直接了，显得自已很市侩很贪财的样子，虽然真是真的。不行，得先迂回一下，先关心关心人家的伤势，显得自已有人情味儿。温栩栩清了清嗓子，努力让自已的语气听起来真诚一点：“啊！司凛同学，你醒了啊！”关心别墅的温栩栩脑子还没转过弯，嘴已经冲出去了：“那个……那个……别墅伤得重不重？几天能交房？呸，出院啊——”话说到一半，温栩栩自已都愣住了。什么玩意儿？别墅伤的重不重？电话那头沉默了一秒。随后传来一声很轻的笑，像是被强行憋回去的那种。司凛的声音慢悠悠地传过来：“别墅伤势还可以，就是有点骨折，医生说静养几天就能出来见人。”温栩栩：“…………”如果人说的话也能顺着信号撤回就好了。司凛打趣道：“你到底是想问别墅，还是想问我？”财迷属性被识破，温栩栩小脸一红，但嘴硬得很：“都、都关心！你先说别墅！”电话那头又是轻轻一笑。温栩栩顾不得尴尬了，她现在是真的急：“那个……我今天被迫从宿舍搬出来了，需要地方落脚放东西。”“别墅什么时候能住？今晚能行吗？”对面沉默了一秒。再开口时，司凛声音还是淡淡的，拽拽的，但不知为什么，温栩栩觉得他好像不太高兴。“被赶出来了？”“呃……也不算赶，就是……”温栩栩想了想，还是没细说，“反正宿舍是住不了了。”电话那头没说话。几秒后，司凛的声音传来，听不出什么情绪：“你在宿舍楼下等着，我马上来接你。”温栩栩一愣：“啊？现在？”“嗯。”“不是……你身体好了吗？你刚出院——”电话已经挂了。此时，温栩栩站在宿舍楼下。大包小包堆在脚边，怀里还抱着一个灰扑扑的黑罐子，看着跟刚从垃圾堆里刨出来的一样。傍晚六点，正是饭点。宿舍楼前人流量达到一天的最高峰。下课回来的、出去吃饭的、取外卖的、遛弯儿的，乌泱泱一群人从她身边经过。她这造型实在太惹眼了。大包小包、灰头土脸、怀里还抱着个咸菜罐子似的破玩意儿——往那儿一站，活脱脱一个“被扫地出门”的模样。路过的人纷纷侧目，小声嘀咕。“那不是贫困生温栩栩吗？怎么像被赶宿舍了？”
content_en: Wen Xuxu carefully stuffed the "pickle jar" worth 1.2 million into the deepest part of the luggage bag, then straightened up and looked back at his bed.The quilt and pillows were so heavy with tatters that they were no longer in their original shape, and there were unknown stains on the sheets. The smell of smoke mixed with mildew in the air made her want to sleep.She silently made a judgment: This dormitory is not enough to live in.Fortunately, her important belongings were locked in the cabinet.Wen Xuxu, wearing gloves used for cleaning the dormitory, carefully pulled away the scraps piled in front of the cabinet.The messier the place, the easier it is for "cuties" to appear, cockroaches, centipedes, unknown bugs, who knows what is hidden in these rags.Wen Xuxu continued to dig through the debris in front of the cabinet. Just as he opened a plastic bag, his movements suddenly stopped.There was a half-drunk pearl milk tea cup with the mouth wide open. Two brown-red things were lying on the wall of the cup, and their thin tentacles were still moving.Mist grass!cockroach!!!Her fingers were hanging in the air, and the blood all over her body instantly surged to the top of her head.The first reaction was to scream.The second reaction was to shake hands.Third reaction - She bit her lower lip and swallowed back the scream that rushed into her throat.Can't bark.If you call them, they will look over.If you look over, you'll notice what she's packing.Just in case, be careful and take this tea can safely away before talking.Wen Xuxu took a deep breath, picked up the lid of the milk tea cup with two fingers, and gently put it back.The movements were very light and steady, as if they were handling something fragile.She put the sealed cup aside and continued to pack the others.No sound was made the whole time.One of the two roommates had her legs crossed and was browsing her phone, and the other was already lying down sleeping, completely unaware of what she had just experienced.Wen Xuxu lowered her head and continued to pick and pack important things, including textbooks and painting supplies.As for the stained sheets and quilts, she didn't even want to touch them.Not staying anymore anyway.When this jar changes hands, my whole body will be worth more than two million.With more than two million dollars, who would live in a dormitory, smoke second-hand smoke, and have cockroaches as roommates?Wen Xuxu picked up the packed luggage bag, walked to the door, and paused.She glanced back.Chen Jing had already fallen into a deep sleep, and the girl who followed the drama had already laid down with her headphones on.No one pays attention to themselves.Wen Xuxu stepped back gently, picked up the sealed milk tea cup from the ground, and placed it on Chen Jing's bedside.The cup stood there steadily, and the two little brown-red things on the cup wall were still crawling around leisurely.Wen Xuxu glanced with satisfaction.Doesn’t Chen Jing like to bully the weak?Don't you like to have fun?Give her two small pets to play with slowly.Wen Xuxu turned around and quickly slipped out.——In the corridor of the dormitory, Wen Xuxu had just breathed a sigh of relief and was thinking about where to stay at night when his cell phone suddenly rang.It's an unfamiliar number, but it says it's from Jinghai City.She hesitated for a second and swiped to answer.A slightly familiar and pleasant male voice came from the other side: "Wen Xuxu? No. 188, Qinglin Bay, a single-family house with a yard. You can come here when it's convenient -" Wen Xuxu was still thinking about where to stay tonight. When she heard this, she thought the other person was going to sell her a house to see a house. She interrupted like a reflex: "No, no! I can't afford a villa! I'm a poor student, so don't ask me to sell it!" There was silence on the other end of the phone for two seconds.Wen Xuxu became more and more enthusiastic as she spoke, lowering her voice and murmuring: "What's going on? Just after I got some money, the real estate agent came to the door smelling the smell? It's too fast..." The voice from the opposite side sounded again, with a hint of indescribable complex emotions: "...Wen Xuxu, I am Si Lin." Wen Xuxu was stunned: "Si Lin...?" Their school's eldest daughter?Seeing Wen Xuxu's slow reaction, Si Lin on the opposite side was silent for another second, with a hint of helplessness in his voice: "You were the one who held me and asked me to pay for the villa." "Lamborghini, bullpen, do you remember it?" There was a "bang" in Wen Xuxu's mind, and he finally dug this memory out of a corner - Si Lin!That school sweetheart Si Rin who drove a Lamborghini and crashed through her bullpen!He's awake!Two thoughts flashed through Wen Xuxu's mind: First, Yue Lao's "Excellent Peach Blossom Luck" red envelope was really not a joke?!Second, and most importantly, does Si Lin really want to compensate her for the villa?!Wen Xuxu's hand tightened on the phone. Her first reaction was to ask about the villa, but she felt that this was too direct and seemed to be very philistine and greedy for money, even though it was true.No, you have to take a detour first, show concern for other people's injuries, and show your human touch.Wen Xuxu cleared her throat and tried to make her tone sound more sincere: "Ah! Classmate Si Lin, you're awake!" Wen Xuxu, who was concerned about the villa, had already rushed out before his mind could turn around: "Um... um... is the villa seriously injured? How many days will it take to hand over the room? Bah, discharged from the hospital -" Wen Xuxu was stunned in the middle of the sentence.What the hell?Is Villa seriously injured?There was silence on the other end of the phone for a second.Then there was a very soft laugh, as if it was being forcibly suppressed.Si Lin's voice came slowly: "The injury in the villa is okay, but there is a slight fracture. The doctor said that he can come out to see people after a few days of rest." Wen Xuxu: "..." It would be nice if people could follow the signal and withdraw what they said.Si Lin joked: "Do you want to ask about the villa, or do you want to ask me?" Wen Xuxu's face turned red when her money-loving nature was revealed, but she said firmly: "They all care! You talk about the villa first!" There was another soft smile on the other end of the phone.Wen Xuxu couldn't care less about her embarrassment. She was really anxious now: "Um...I was forced to move out of the dormitory today. I need a place to put my things." "When can I live in the villa? Is it possible tonight?" There was silence for a second.When he spoke again, Si Lin's voice was still light and harsh, but for some reason, Wen Xuxu felt that he seemed unhappy."Kicked out?" "Uh... not really kicked out, just..." Wen Xuxu thought for a moment, but didn't elaborate, "Anyway, we can't live in the dormitory anymore." There was no word on the other end of the phone.A few seconds later, Si Lin's voice came, and there was no emotion in it: "Wait downstairs in the dormitory, I'll pick you up right away." Wen Xuxu was stunned: "Ah? Now?" "Yeah." "No... are you feeling well? You have just been discharged from the hospital-" The phone has been hung up.At this time, Wen Xuxu was standing downstairs in the dormitory.Big and small bags were piled at his feet, and he was holding a dusty black jar in his arms, which looked like it had just been dug out of the garbage.At six o'clock in the evening, it's dinner time.The flow of people in front of the dormitory building reached the highest peak of the day.A crowd of people came back from get out of class, went out to eat, picked up takeaways, and walked around. A large group of people passed by her.Her look is really eye-catching.With big bags and small bags, a gray face, and a shabby pickle jar-like thing in his arms--when he stood there, he looked like he had been "kicked out."People passing by looked sideways and whispered."Isn't that Wen Xuxu, a poor student? Why does it look like he was kicked out of the dormitory?"
